name: What is the process of filing an obstetric malpractice claim?

mainEntity.name: What is the process of filing an obstetric malpractice claim?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process of filing an obstetric malpractice claim typically begins with a detailed consultation and review of your medical records by an attorney and medical experts. If negligence is identified, your attorney will usually send a notice of intent to sue to the healthcare providers involved. This is followed by filing a formal complaint in court. The process then involves discovery, where evidence is exchanged, and depositions are taken. Many cases resolve through mediation or settlement negotiations before going to trial.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves medical record review, filing a formal complaint, discovery, and potentially settlement negotiations or trial.
